final: WITH per AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_rc, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS fee_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(fee_per_day) AS overall_avg FROM per WHERE fee_per_day IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_rc, p.fee_per_day, p.fee_per_day / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall FROM per p JOIN overall o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.rating
